rules.no-blue: Never use #2563EB or any blue. Green for primary, orange for links.
rules.signal-green-ceiling: Signal Green max 10% of viewport. Accent, not surface.
rules.garamond-ceiling: EB Garamond for logotype and landing display headings only.
rules.green-glow-monopoly: Only primary CTA button gets the green glow shadow.
rules.svak-text-warning: #a09b8f fails AA on light bg. Metadata only, never labels.
